explanation: The detected set is contained in the union over tests of the solution sets {t in S : a_i t + b_i = 0} (Finset.biUnion). Each has at most one element: two solutions t, t' give a_i (t - t') = 0, so t = t' when a_i != 0, and when a_i = 0 the test reads b_i = 0, excluded. Finset.card_biUnion_le and sum_le_sum then bound the union by the number of tests.
